title: Process crashes after the external system committed
description: The gateway process stops after the scheduling system committed the change and before the ledger recorded COMMITTED. On restart the action is UNKNOWN until reconciled.
callerVisible: The caller is told the change is being confirmed and is not told it is done until reconciliation finds authoritative commit evidence.
backendEvidence: Ledger UNKNOWN state reconciled by idempotency key or authoritative lookup

registry.injectionPoint: worker process death between the provider commit and the ledger record (two workers on postgres:16)

postconditions: The external commit exists before the ledger records it (the fault point is the commit, not an earlier step)
The action is UNKNOWN until reconciled by idempotency key or authoritative lookup; no success is announced before reconciliation
Exactly one external effect; retry only after reconciliation
